title: Esxence brings 30 Italian niche fragrance brands to New York's AURA
summary: Following its inaugural edition in 2025, the second edition of AURA took place at Aspire at One World Observatory in New York on October 22, 2026. Organized by Esxence - The Art Perfumery Event in partnership with the Italian Trade Agency (ITA), the invitation-only event brought together 30 Italian artistic perfumery brands to showcase their creations to US buyers, distributors, and media professionals.
